# Clinical Consequence

This folder captures the direct clinical impacts and patient outcomes resulting from healthcare processes and surgical interventions. It specifically documents evidence linking operational factors, such as operating room wait times, to adverse outcomes like increased mortality and prolonged hospital stays, alongside data on the timing of post-operative deaths.

## Pages

- [[clinical-consequence|Clinical Consequence]] — Details claims linking operating room wait times to increased mortality and longer hospital stays, and notes that approximately 30% of post-operative deaths occur between 30 and 90 days after the procedure.
